title: Professional Certificate Course in Macroeconomic Growth Theories
description: Embark on a dynamic exploration of macroeconomic growth theory, unravelling the intricacies of economic expansion and policy interventions in a rapidly evolving global landscape.
longDescription: Know what is meant by macroeconomics Understand how economic growth is measured and what is the difference between real and nominal GDP. Know how central bank uses monetary policy to achieve the objectives of price stability, full employment and sustained economic growth. Learn the evolution of growth theories from classical growth theories to neoclassical growth theories and then New growth theory. Delve into the realm of macroeconomics, gaining insights into the measurement of economic growth, the role of monetary policy in achieving macroeconomic objectives, and the evolution of growth theories over time. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: This course provides a comprehensive examination of macroeconomic growth theory, encompassing the measurement of economic growth, the objectives of monetary policy, and the evolution of growth theories. Participants will gain a deep understanding of the differences between real and nominal GDP, the mechanisms through which central banks influence economic outcomes, and the theoretical frameworks that underpin our understanding of economic growth. Through a blend of theoretical analysis and practical applications, learners will emerge equipped to navigate the complexities of macroeconomic policy-making and analysis in a dynamic global economy.
